description: Fix the broken link: persist the published state of the 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set' into the committed source of truth so the storefront build includes it. Add the 4 real image records recovered from local R2 to data/products/brown-sofa.json, set status PUBLISHED and published true, and update the regression test to guard the published state. This is the smallest change that makes /collection and /product/brown-sofa render the product while satisfying the canonical publish gate and schema invariants. Read .agents/tasks/task-publish-brown-sofa/recovered-images.md FIRST — it contains the exact image ids, R2 keys, intrinsic dimensions, derivative widths/formats, primary/order and alt-text decisions confirmed by the user, plus where the LQIP data URL is stored.
status_note: status set to completed; see status field below and findings.
steps: Read src/schemas/product.ts (ProductImage schema + enforceProductInvariants) and src/schemas/publish-gate.ts to confirm the exact field shape and invariants before editing.

Edit data/products/brown-sofa.json ONLY: (a) set `images` to the 4 records in this exact order/primary — order 0 = img_tchmzkuoeb (1470x1070, WITH the lqip from img_tchmzkuoeb.lqip.txt), order 1 = img_ey2dy4u4kt (1468x1071), order 2 = img_s8k3oxoflo (1468x1071), order 3 = img_tlutq0cci2 (1469x1071). For each record set: id, key='products/p_322e7n6mth/{id}/original.webp', alt (numbered per recovered-images.md, non-empty), width, height, order, altSource='admin', mime='image/webp', derivativesReady=true, derivativeWidths=[320,480,640,960,1280], derivativeFormats=['avif','webp','jpeg']; include lqip only on img_tchmzkuoeb. (b) set `primaryImage`='img_tchmzkuoeb'. (c) set `status`='PUBLISHED' and `published`=true. (d) keep `stockStatus`='IN_STOCK'. (e) set `updatedAt` to a current ISO-8601 datetime. Do NOT change id, sku, slug, name, price, currency, category, description, material, tags, seoTitle, seoDescription, or any other field. Leave the inert `imageStatus`/`pendingImageAlt`/`pendingImageOrder` passthrough keys as-is.

Match the repo's deterministic JSON formatting: keys sorted alphabetically, two-space indent, trailing newline (see README 'GitHub integration -> Deterministic bytes'). The existing file is already sorted; keep it sorted after edits so validate:content and the minimal-diff expectation hold.

Run `npx tsx scripts/validate-content.ts` (npm run validate:content) and confirm brown-sofa.json passes the canonical schema. Fix any invariant violations (published/status mirror, image order contiguity 0..3, primaryImage references an owned id, alt non-empty).
Add a runtime assertion that the record passes the publish gate: in a scratch check or by extending the test below, confirm checkPublishGate(brownSofa).ok === true now.

Rewrite tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts so it guards the NEW published state rather than the old draft state. Specifically: brown-sofa must now assert status==='PUBLISHED', published===true, images.length===4, isCatalogueProduct(brownSofa)===true, checkPublishGate(brownSofa).ok===true, primaryImage==='img_tchmzkuoeb', and each image has non-empty alt and a key matching /^products\/p_322e7n6mth\/img_[a-z0-9]{10}\/original\.webp$/. KEEP and DO NOT WEAKEN the identity/WhatsApp assertions: brownSofa.sku==='NGF-SOF-WBJZX0', name==='Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set', slug==='brown-sofa', price===41990, and buildEnquiryMessage produces the exact message ending '(SKU: NGF-SOF-WBJZX0).' + newline + 'I would like to enquire about the price, availability and order details.' and never contains 'Corner Sofa'. corner-sofa MUST remain a DRAFT image-less product: keep its existing draft/gate/exclusion assertions unchanged. Remove now-false assertions that pinned brown-sofa as DRAFT/images:0/imageStatus-marker, replacing them with the published-state assertions; do not delete the corner-sofa cases.
Run `npx vitest run tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts` and confirm all cases pass.
Run `npm run check` and confirm 0 type errors.

Run `npm test` (full suite) and confirm the ONLY failures are the exact pre-existing baseline failures recorded in FEAT-001 findings — no new failures. If any catalogue/search/sitemap/product-page test now fails because the catalogue is no longer empty, that is in-scope: read the test and update it correctly (the product legitimately now appears), do not suppress it.

Run `npm run build` (set PUBLIC_SITE_URL if the build requires it; CI uses http://localhost:4321). Confirm the build succeeds through the postbuild audits (audit-image-loading in particular, since the product now has images).

Verify the built storefront: confirm dist/client/product/brown-sofa/index.html exists and contains 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set'; confirm dist/client/collection/index.html lists the product; confirm a wa.me link on the product page whose ?text= param URL-decodes (single decode) to a message containing 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set (SKU: NGF-SOF-WBJZX0)'. Record the exact grep/checks used and their output in findings.

Confirm no duplicate: grep data/products/ for the SKU NGF-SOF-WBJZX0, the id p_322e7n6mth, and the slug brown-sofa — each must match exactly one file (brown-sofa.json); confirm no data/products/premium-3-1-1-sofa-set.json exists.
acceptance_criteria: data/products/brown-sofa.json has status PUBLISHED, published true, exactly 4 image records with the recovered ids/keys/dimensions and non-empty alt, primaryImage img_tchmzkuoeb, and all other identity/content fields byte-identical to before (id p_322e7n6mth, sku NGF-SOF-WBJZX0, slug brown-sofa, name 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set', price 41990)
npm run validate:content passes and checkPublishGate(brownSofa).ok === true
npx vitest run tests/unit/real-content-sofas.test.ts passes with rewritten published-state assertions; corner-sofa remains asserted as an image-less DRAFT
npm test shows no failures beyond the FEAT-001 baseline
npm run build succeeds and dist/client/collection/index.html includes the product and dist/client/product/brown-sofa/index.html exists with the exact name and a correct wa.me SKU message
Exactly one product file carries SKU NGF-SOF-WBJZX0 / id p_322e7n6mth / slug brown-sofa; no second sofa product is created
verification: npm run build then inspect dist/client/collection/index.html and dist/client/product/brown-sofa/index.html for the product name and the decoded wa.me SKU message

findings.deviation_alt_text: recovered-images.md specified alt text of the form 'Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set by New Galaxy Furniture[ — view N]'. Built with those, the postbuild audit `lint-keyword-density` FAILED (build-gating) on THREE pages because the Gallery/card fallback <figcaption> renders each image alt as VISIBLE text inside <main>: product/brown-sofa 'New Galaxy Furniture' x4 in 329 words = 3.65%, /gallery x4 in 87 words = 13.79%, /collection x1 in 130 words = 2.31% (ceiling 2%). Root cause is a single content decision (the brand suffix repeated across 4 gallery captions + the collection/gallery cards), and it is entirely a consequence of publishing this product. Verified it is NOT pre-existing: on the base commit a clean `npx astro build` + `npx tsx scripts/lint-keyword-density.ts` reported '24 page(s) checked; no target phrase exceeds 2%' (PASS). Per the audit's own guidance ('Remove the repetition rather than the phrase'), dropped the redundant 'by New Galaxy Furniture' brand suffix from the 4 gallery image `alt` values, leaving honest descriptive alt ('Premium 3+1+1 Sofa Set', '... — view 2/3/4'). Images still have non-empty alt (publish gate + test still pass); keys/ids/order/primaryImage unchanged; product identity unchanged. imageAltText (legacy OG alt) was left with the brand.
